title: LETTER 1: Complaint to Bank Manager — Poor ATM Service

blocks.content: Topic: You are Priya Sharma, a customer of State Bank of India, Rajpur Branch. Write a letter to the Branch Manager complaining about repeated ATM failures and requesting immediate resolution.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Follow the standard formal letter format: Sender Address, Date, Receiver Address, Subject Line, Salutation, Body, and Formal Sign-off.
Clearly mention key transaction specifics including Date, Time, ATM Location, Account Number, and Transaction Reference ID.
Detail the precise operational issue faced, such as un-dispensed cash, debited amount without cash payout, or out-of-order machine.
Maintain a professional, firm, and courteous tone throughout the letter without using informal language.
Conclude with a specific call to action requesting an urgent prompt investigation and reversal of debited funds.

blocks.content: I request you to kindly look into the matter urgently and ensure that the debited amount is credited back to my account at the earliest.
Subject: Complaint Regarding Repeated ATM Failures and Request for Immediate Redressal

I am Priya Sharma, a Savings Account holder with your branch (Account No. XXXX XXXX 1234) for the past six years. I am writing to bring to your kind attention a matter of serious inconvenience that I and several other residents of this locality have been experiencing for the past three weeks.

The ATM machine installed at your branch premises has been non-functional on multiple occasions during this period. On three separate instances — on the 3rd, 8th, and 12th of this month — the machine displayed an 'Out of Service' message during peak hours. On one occasion, a transaction was debited from my account but cash was not dispensed, causing both financial loss and significant stress. I had to travel over four kilometres to the nearest alternative ATM, which is particularly challenging for senior citizens and persons with disabilities in our neighbourhood.

I would like to request you to kindly take immediate steps to ensure the ATM functions reliably, arrange for prompt refund of the failed transaction amount (Rs. 5,000), and consider installing a second ATM or Cash Deposit Machine at this location, given the high footfall in the area.
I trust that your office will address this matter with the urgency it deserves. I would be grateful for a written acknowledgement of this complaint and the steps being taken.

items: Strictly avoid writing personal names or actual phone numbers in competitive exam scripts to prevent disqualification under UFM (Unfair Means) rules; use placeholders like ABC or XYZ if specified.
Ensure the Subject line is short, clear, and focused (e.g., 'Subject: Complaint regarding failed ATM transaction and non-dispensation of cash').
Organize the body text logically across three clear paragraphs: Opening/Purpose, Details/Incident Facts, and Closing/Request for Resolution.

blocks.content: Examiner's Tip: This letter covers all 3 paragraphs: context (para 1), detailed problem with specific dates and amounts (para 2), and clear requests (para 3). Specific details like account numbers, dates, and amounts make the complaint credible.
